scene.speaker: mateo
scene.bubble: Club tradition: pancake Saturday at Café Aurora! I always order the same… everything.
scene.intro: Club tradition: pancake Saturday at Café Aurora! Can I have pancakes with honey, please? asks Mateo, who always orders the same. Can I have a hot chocolate and some toast? asks Valentina. Anything else? says the waiter. Yes — more pancakes. Then comes the bill, and everybody looks for coins. What do you order in a café? Practise and ask politely!

data.script: Mateo: Good morning! A table for four, please. Next to the window! … Mateo: Can I have pancakes with honey, please? … Mateo: Valentina wants toast with cheese and a hot chocolate. … Mateo: Erik and Sofia want the fruit bowl with yoghurt — to share. … Mateo: And a little water for Luna, please. She's waiting outside. … Mateo: Anything else? Hmm… one more pancake. For scientific reasons. … Mateo: The bill? Fourteen soles. We pay together — club rules! … Mateo: Everything was delicious. See you next Saturday!
